reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Cavaliers.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 59 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 209 and 257 total points.
